get_alpha()[source]

Given the conductance distribution’s mu and sigma variables, get alpha. At the moment, we calculate alpha such that the incominig concentration, which is 1, blocks an edge with 50% chance.

get_scaled_mean()[source]

The mean above is not the mean unless the structure is 4-reg, since otherwise the conductances are scaled for a fair test. Here we scale the mean by the correct scale factor.
